12.name: App praise and enjoyment
12.problem: Customers express appreciation and love for the applications

examples.text: I love the gmail app.
WhatsApp is an amazing app.
I have been using this app for a very long time and I must say that I was really satisfied with everything about the app.

12.name: Lack of text formatting options
12.problem: Customers want more ways to format text and personalize their experience.

examples.text: There should be more formatting options.
I wish there was SOME type of text formatting options.
Maybe there could be an option for that in settings to give us more personalization.

12.name: Desire for better organization
12.problem: Customers want help organizing their daily thoughts and tasks more efficiently.

examples.text: At the end of a day, I like to organize my thoughts about what I should do the following day.
I’m more organized and productive already.
I have a busy personal life and manage complex, multi-phased projects for work.

12.name: Product appreciation and design
12.problem: Customers are expressing satisfaction with the features and design without stating a problem.

examples.text: I understand the features of this some may find appealing.
I had really hoped that customizability would be better and more abundant as well.These are my biggest complaints.
The design is clean and functional, it’s packed with features, but user friendly and easy to get started.

12.name: Notification and account management issues
12.problem: Customers struggle with ambiguous notifications, password recovery due to incorrect emails, and missing important inbox alerts.

examples.text: I have multiple accounts and sometimes I’m not sure which account the notification is referring to when I know I’ve read all the messages.
Then I lost my password and can’t change it since the emails wrong.
On a separate issue, I don’t get notified about all emails coming into my primary inbox, which has caused me to miss that someone wrote to me until days later.

12.name: Updates failing to fix issues
12.problem: Customers experience persistent issues that remain unresolved even after updating the software.

examples.text: An update came through and that still did not fix the issue.
I had this problem a few months ago and even when I updated it, it still doesn’t work.
I’ve contacted support and the only thing they could tell me was to upgrade to the newest version of it.

12.name: In-game currency acquisition is too slow
12.problem: Players feel that earning enough money to purchase different types of trees takes an excessively long time.

examples.text: For one thing, getting enough money to buy a different type of tree takes FOREVER!
It’s worth every penny because you also know that your money is in good hands that are willing to help the world by planting real trees.
Additionally, the money goes to help plant real trees, which makes you feel great about the small amount spent.

12.name: Call audio volume and quality issues
12.problem: Customers experience low volume, missing audio, or distorted music after calls.

examples.text: Whenever I enter a call I always have to switch over to speaker because the normal audio is too quiet for me to hear anyone even at full volume.
Doesn’t like to be off WiFi so much, sometimes the audio has problems without hearing everyone else even though you joined the call.
Also, if I’m listening to music when I join a call and then leave, my music will have messed up audio after.

12.name: App updates and reinstalls fail
12.problem: Troubleshooting steps like updating and reinstalling the app do not resolve the issue.

examples.text: I have the most updated version of the app as well so please don’t tell me that this is the issue.
I have removed the app and reinstalled it and that didnt help.
I updated the app, hoping it would fix the problem, but it has not.

12.name: Device and operating system compatibility
12.problem: Customers are unsure if the app is compatible with their specific device and operating system versions.

examples.text: Works on iPad 12 iOS.
I am running on an old iPad 2, iOS 9.3.5.
Both devices running the latest iOS.

12.name: Core functionality and usability expectations
12.problem: Customers feel the app fails at its fundamental purpose of storing, finding, and efficiently managing notes.

examples.text: The point of a notes app is that it store notes and be able to find them again.
I suggest you find another note taking app if you take a lot of notes.
A notes app should be quick and easy to use.

Discord is an amazing app, and I love it.

20.name: Lack of folder organization
20.problem: Customers cannot organize documents or stickers into folders, causing clutter and difficulty in finding items.

examples.text: That would be very helpful cause I love to write and having folders would keep everything organized and I thing that lots would enjoy that.On the other (ever)note (sorry couldn’t help myself) the free version has everything that I’ve been looking for.
Our biggest request is to please allow us to organize our stickers (maybe by sorting them into folders/tabs) because we have so many and they get lost in the bunch.
It would be SUPER useful if we could do that, since we sometimes wanna list things by hand or sort things exactly the way we want them.

20.name: Missing message and email notifications
20.problem: Customers are not receiving alerts for new messages and emails, causing them to miss important communications.

examples.text: But it doesn't alert me when I get a message.
On a separate issue, I don’t get notified about all emails coming into my primary inbox, which has caused me to miss that someone wrote to me until days later.
Edited: There is a notification setting after all!

20.name: Call Screen Behavior Issues
20.problem: Calls end when locking the phone or the screen fails to turn off during calls.

examples.text: Another thing to note is that the call ends when you lock your phone, this is honestly VERY annoying.
Not only that, but my phone won’t turn the screen off when it’s in a call.
I don’t use my phone for calls or texts unless it’s important and I hate not being able to use it to write or call back right away.

20.name: Account compromise and lack of access
20.problem: Users are locked out of their compromised accounts while support fails to restore access or protect their information.

examples.text: I changed my password and they still have access to my account as I write now while Evernote did nothing to protect there users info.
Is there anyway I can get my account back?
My account has not been given back to me and it has been over a month.

20.name: Pricing and subscription models
20.problem: Customers have mixed views and experiences regarding subscription costs versus one-time payments and premium access.

examples.text: (Plus cheaper too at just a 1 time payment instead of a subscription based payment).
I’ve never paid a cent to use it, and I’m nowhere near where I need to be to require premium.
One of the main things I pay for premium for.

20.name: Cursor jumping while editing text
20.problem: The text editing cursor unexpectedly jumps to the end of the text or paragraph when attempting to make corrections or move around.

examples.text: And if I go back to edit it, the cursor gets moved to the end of the paragraph after the first character is corrected.
It also happens to certain text when composing a new email.
I can’t move the writing cursor on the text I’m writing without it going all the way down.

20.name: Changing review ratings
20.problem: Customers are changing their review ratings due to shifting experiences or resolved issues.

examples.text: One star review now down from 5 stars.
I previously gave this app a five star review.
The issue of my review has been resolved and I have changed my review to 5 stars.

20.name: Audio routing and volume issues
20.problem: Audio plays through the wrong speaker or is too quiet during calls and media playback.

examples.text: For instance, when I set it to voice activated and play, say a YouTube video, those in the channel can hear it, this wasn't a issue before.
Whenever I enter a call I always have to switch over to speaker because the normal audio is too quiet for me to hear anyone even at full volume.
Audio messages are played through the speaker for all to hear.

20.name: Photo sharing and uploading issues
20.problem: Customers experience bugs and inconveniences when sending or uploading photos to friends.

examples.text: One thing that could be better is when I send pics to my friends, they receive a link that will direct them to my pic...
There is a bug that prevents me from uploading photos.
People can't send u photos?

20.name: Variety and real-world tree planting
20.problem: Customers want more ways to track or understand the real-world tree planting process.

examples.text: I really like the assortment of trees, so you can set goals to get new trees or get enough coins to plant a tree in real life.
The different types of trees are awesome and being able to earn coins to plant a real tree feels really nice too. :)
I especially love the idea that with enough coins you can actually get a real tree planted too!

20.name: Dark mode and color scheme
20.problem: Customers want a dark mode feature and find the current color scheme too bright.

examples.text: In the next update, you should definitely add a dark mode feature!
Dark mode is okay but the colors are a too bright.
I am also not a fan of the new color scheme and will hope for a dark mode in the next update.
